market_summary: FX pairs (EURUSD and GBPUSD) are showing synchronized downside momentum during London Session, breaking below session Value Areas and key support baselines with elevated volume confirmation. XAUUSD is consolidating near VWAP/EMA50 within its Value Area. US100 remains in an uptrend but is extended at session highs near upper ATR bounds. BTCUSD shows signs of a false breakout above VAH with upper wicks and mild CVD divergence.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4039.33..VAH 4059.52) and above POC 4044.58. CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.69) with negative slope (-0.19). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding just above VWAP (4048.72) and EMA50 (4051.07), consolidated mid-channel between ATR bands with low RVOL (0.738). Rejection candles near S/R 4052.38 suggest compression and lack of directional momentum. HOLD advised.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral slightly above VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (1.11445) and well below POC (1.11658). CVD is BEARISH (-3710.26), matching sell pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price expanded below both VWAP (1.11532) and EMA50 (1.11560) and is hugging the lower ATR band (1.11356). RVOL spikes confirmed the breakdown through Prev Low (1.11456) towards Session Low (1.11314). Strong bearish momentum alignment.

Price is below VAL (1.33232) and below POC (1.33468). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1421.0). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Trend is structurally bearish below VWAP (1.33343) and EMA50 (1.33381). Price is pressing against the lower ATR band (1.33146) and testing Session Low (1.33141). Recent yellow RVOL spikes confirmed the leg down from S/R 1.33320. High potential for continuation lower.
signals.level_event: acceptance below VAL testing Session Low

signals.rationale: Price is inside VA (VAL 28017.71..VAH 28261.60) near VAH and well above POC 28114.25. CVD is BULLISH (+8.28) but short-term slope is fading (-0.22). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP (28078.45) and EMA50 (28066.38), but testing upper ATR band (28259.00) and Session High (28261.60) where it shows top wicks/resistance. While Dukascopy US100 volume rarely shows RVOL > 2.0, buying at the extreme upper band into resistance without fresh acceleration presents poor immediate risk/reward. Wait for pullback.

Price is above VAH (73808.59) and POC (73660.40). However, CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) presenting a divergence. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73644.23) and EMA50 (73694.06), but the latest signal candle shows a prominent upper wick rejecting near Session High (74085.20) back below S/R 73975.30. RVOL is standard (1.089) without breakout confirmation. Divergence and rejection signal potential fakeout/reversion back into the Value Area. HOLD.
signals.level_event: rejection at Session High 74085.20 and S/R 73975.30
